# Facets of Origin v0.3 — read-only snapshot

These are the v0.3 rulebooks (Player's Handbook, MM Manual, Bestiary) exactly as they
stood at the git tag `pre-lean-facets`, copied here so all three rulesets can be read side
by side. See `COMPARISON.md` at the repository root.

**Do not edit.** Nothing here is maintained, generated indexes inside these books are
frozen, and the software engine does not run v0.3 (it runs Lean Facets). The tag remains
the authoritative copy: `git show pre-lean-facets:player_handbook/...`.
